[[File:Josh Radke portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Josh Radke.]]
'''Josh Radke''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 84 from Terryville, Ct. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> He wrote TheForce.Net's Flashback Premiere interview with [[Chuck Kallenbach]], bylined as Red 84.
